Kenon and IC Power have entered into an agreement with a capital provider to provide capital for expenses in relation to the pursuit of their arbitration claims against Peru and other costs.

In the event that Kenon or IC Power receives proceeds in connection with the Award or settlement thereof, the capital provider will be entitled to be repaid the amount committed by the capital provider (which, to date, has equaled $12 million) and to receive up to approximately 55% of the net claim proceeds, subject to the terms of the agreement among Kenon, IC Power and the capital provider.
